question: Does Apple invoke the route-selection completion synchronously or after return, on which queue, and with which (Bool, RouteSelection) pair when no route hardware exists?
reason: The sealed runner has no run loop, so Linux now invokes the completion synchronously, exactly once, with (false, .none). Apple's queue identity and values are unconfirmed.

question: When AVPlayerItem.status becomes readyToPlay with a non-zero presentationSize, does Apple set isReadyForDisplay before the first decoded pixel, and is the KVO key readyForDisplay or isReadyForDisplay?
reason: Linux treats readyToPlay plus a non-zero presentationSize as the display-state model and assigns videoBounds from that size. Isolated-host Foundation has no ObjC willChangeValue/didChangeValue. Apple's first-frame timing is unobserved.

question: Does Apple call skipByInterval on a queue, and must the async overlay be awaited before stopPictureInPicture?
reason: Linux now exposes the ObjC completion-handler selector and the host hook invokes it synchronously, then the default impl calls completionHandler() immediately. The Swift async overlay is still un-awaited by the sealed runner. Apple's queue identity is unobserved.

question: Are AVRouteDetector, AVNavigationMarkersGroup, AVPlayerView, canStopPictureInPicture, and transportBarCustomMenuItems part of the iPhoneOS 26.1 AVKit graph for this seed?
reason: They are absent from reference/public-surface.tsv. Linux does not invent them. AVRoutePickerView stays fail-closed with no route sheet.

question: Which AVKitError.Code does Apple throw for a missing or unreadable custom capture-sound URL, and does a well-formed CAF succeed without capture hardware?
reason: Pinned graphs declare a throwing URL initializer but not the failure code. Linux throws unknown and never loads audio bytes.

question: Does present() set isPresented to true before willBeginPresenting, and does dismiss() no-op when already dismissed?
reason: No input-picker UI exists on the isolated host. Linux keeps isPresented false for both present and dismiss. Apple presentation sequencing is unobserved.

question: Which NSCoder keys does Apple use for AVInterstitialTimeRange, and does a host-written archive decode on Apple AVKit?
reason: Linux round-trips start.value / start.timescale / duration.value / duration.timescale. Apple's key names were not dumped from an Apple-encoded blob.

question: What localizedName strings does Apple return for systemDefaultSpeeds under locales other than en_US?
reason: en_US on iPhone 16 / iOS 26.1 is Double / Faster / Fast / Normal / Half. Other locales are unobserved.

question: When isPictureInPictureSupported is false and the controller was built with init(contentSource:), does Apple call failedToStartPictureInPictureWithError, and with which localizedDescription / userInfo?
reason: Apple documents the failedToStart delegate (https://developer.apple.com/documentation/avkit/avpictureinpicturecontrollerdelegate/pictureinpicturecontroller(_:failedtostartpictureinpicturewitherror:)). First-pass simulator probe (OpenUIKit-Chrome-fw-avkit, iPhone 16 / iOS 26.1) observed no callback. Linux fail-closed delivers AVKitError.pictureInPictureStartFailed (-1001) with no extra userInfo. Apple's unsupported-path payload is unobserved.

question: Does assigning AVPlayerViewController.player subscribe to AVPlayer.rate / status / timeControlStatus KVO, and which of those keys flip isReadyForDisplay?
reason: Linux refreshes display state from the current item's status and presentationSize when player is assigned. Isolated-host AVPlayerItem is not KVO-compliant, so later size mutations need openUIKitHostRefreshDisplayState. Apple's rate / status / timeControlStatus subscription is unobserved.

question: After selectSpeed of a list member, does assigning a new AVPlayer keep selectedSpeed or overwrite it from the new player's defaultRate even when that rate is 1.0?
reason: MEASURED: assigning a player with defaultRate 1.5 selects the 1.5 entry. The selectSpeed-then-replace-player order and KVO of defaultRate were not probed.

question: In which order does Apple call willBegin / willEnd relative to the animation coordinator's animate(alongside:) / completion, and on which queue?
reason: Linux never enters full screen. The host hook delivers willBegin then willEnd so tests can observe that documented pair (https://developer.apple.com/documentation/avkit/avplayerviewcontrollerdelegate). Coordinator animate(alongside:) timing is unobserved.

question: Does VideoPlayer.body update the representable when player.rate changes without reconstructing VideoPlayer, and is overlay z-order above or below the player view?
reason: Linux recomputes a caption from player.rate at init/read time and stacks the overlay in a ZStack. Apple's UIViewRepresentable update and z-order are unobserved; no decoded frames are claimed.

question: Does Apple's bridged AVKitError hash only domain and code, or also userInfo contents?
reason: Linux hashes NSError domain and code so Foundation's protocol-default hash witnesses do not trap. Equality remains userInfo-sensitive via NSError. Apple hashing is unconfirmed.

question: Must every Linux PiP, route-picker, and capture-sound path stay fail-closed until an Apple AVKit runtime exists, or is a documented local subset allowed to succeed?
reason: Fabricating PiP windows, AirPlay routes, or capture clicks would claim Apple service success. This starting point never activates those sessions.
